title: Japan Real Estate Scraper
description: Scrape property listings from RealEstate.co.jp. Provide a start URL or use search filters like location, property type, and price range.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Full RealEstate.co.jp search URL to scrape. Overrides other filters if provided. Example: https://realestate.co.jp/en/forsale/listing?prefecture=JP-13

location.title: Location (Prefecture Code)
location.description: Japanese prefecture code. Example: JP-13 (Tokyo), JP-27 (Osaka), JP-14 (Kanagawa). Leave empty for nationwide search.

propertyType.title: Property Type
propertyType.description: Filter by property type: mansion-apartment, house, office, hotel, landonly, terrace_house, town_house

minPrice.title: Minimum Price (JPY)
minPrice.description: Minimum property price in Japanese Yen.

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (JPY)
maxPrice.description: Maximum property price in Japanese Yen.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of property listings to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on number of search result pages to visit.

withDetail.title: Enrich with Detail Data
withDetail.description: Visit each property detail page to extract gallery images, floor plan, description, land area, construction year, structure details, and more. Adds ~1s per property.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for reliable scraping (residential recommended for Japan).
